_help: What the MCP server (app-tests/mcp, started with MCP_APP=wikipedia) needs to know about this app: its name and package, the .env key of the device id, the device suites the assistant may start (npm run test:<suite>) and what a run does to the device. The assistant shows 'effects' to the user before a run starts.
name: Wikipedia

smoke.what: install and start the built APK, intro, tabs, search, an article, Settings (8 tests)

tour.what: every bottom-bar screen and a new reading list (8 tests)

effects: Appium installs the newest APK built in out/ every run (npm run build:apk is NOT run) and CLEARS the Wikipedia app's data: every run starts like a fresh install.
No login; the tests need internet and only read Wikipedia (nothing is edited).
